A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with the corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-chewbacca-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Chewbacca (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text changes: “Falcon,” becomes “''Falcon'',”; “starships” becomes “starships,”; “that are 'hit' and about to be lost” is added after “site”; “(rather than Lost Pile) when they are 'hit.'” becomes “instead.”. The title is gone from the black lower border; only the white italic “E” remains.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, each as cut from its sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
